scientificFindings.finding: Both current CrossStage LK views omit all11 from target and prerequisiteOnly. Target81373 directly requires absent70b34, target91cd directly requires absente9b61, and actual binding/atom targets directly require absent9b56/448815/72236. These direct canonical atomic prerequisites fail closed in the inspected backend. A fresh learner cannot acquire the affected targets through this projection. Persisted mastery of missing goals itself does not bypass the explicit missing-role guard; actual mastery of an already acquired dependent can bypass needing to acquire it again, but is not a curriculum-wide justification.

The whole organic chain is not scientifically defensible as a universal acquisition requirement for qualitative phosphate buffering. In particular81373→70b34 and91cd→e9b61 carry contextual ester/isomer routines into general equilibrium/polar-property competence. Do not close this by calling all11 automatic entry knowledge, bulk masterying them, or adding new completion targets without source/scope judgment.

9b56 EPA,448815 bonding and72236 core-shell are plausible genuine prior foundations for the existing geometry/polarity/energy-level targets, even if taught earlier. Explicit prerequisiteOnly can model reviewed entry support without adding ordinary completion duties; it must preserve real mastery checks and cannot be inferred from phase/SekI tags.

Four IDs5851/858d/345f/536b have no direct visible target dependent in these views, but appear behind other omitted goals in the canonical chain. They are not four additional immediate runtime blockers or four new content-review quotas. Their scientific necessity depends on retaining or correcting the earlier interfaces; they are not declared harmless.
